info.name: Tyk Dashboard Admin Additional Permissions Organisation Quotas API
info.description:
For Tyk On-Premises installations only, the Dashboard Admin API has two endpoints and is used to set up and provision a Tyk Dashboard instance without the command line.

In order to use the Dashboard Admin API, you'll need to get the `admin_secret` value from your Tyk Dashboard configurations.

The secret you set should then be sent along as a header with each Dashboard Admin API Request in order for it to be successful:

```
admin-auth: <your-secret>
```

request.description:
This work similar to Keys API except that Key ID is always equals Organisation ID

For Gateway v2.6.0 onwards, you can now set rate limits at the organisation level by using the following fields - allowance and rate. These are the number of allowed requests for the specified per value, and need to be set to the same value. If you don't want to have organisation level rate limiting, set `rate` or `per` to zero, or don't add them to your request.
